workflow: .agents/skills/skill-model: PokeAPI official artwork → openrouter/google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1 2×2 sheet → split-sheet.py → multiview-to-model
budgetNote: Part of the 3000-credit zone-content grant (docs/ZONE-CONTENT.md §2, models 30–37). Account balance is shared with concurrent batches, so per-batch balance before/after is not recorded; credits come from each task record.
shippingPipeline: assets/prepare-game-models.py (Blender 5.2.3); swarm 900 triangles (onix, omastar) or 1300 (dodrio, rapidash, kabutops, rhydon), 512px base colour; guardians undecimated, 1024px; no rigging or paid conversion
facingVerification: Raw and shipping GLBs rendered from the run camera and four sides with render-compare.py next to rattata.glb, plus a lineup at proposed sim heights next to rattata, golem and scyther; all eight face glTF +X like rattata, so they take the default yaw (-π/2) and need no facingYaw entry.
rights: Unofficial, free non-commercial Pokémon fan project. Pokémon characters and names belong to their respective rights holders. AI generation does not transfer those character rights.

assets.name: 嘎啦嘎啦
assets.note: Guardian (desert zone 2): static, undecimated, 1024px texture, like scyther. The multiview mesh (taskId 1e8e8a7f) came back with a blank grey base colour; the shipping file is Tripo texture_model on that same mesh (10 credits), which restored the brown body, cream belly and white skull. Bone club is in its right hand. Sheet 2: sheet.jpg had grid lines and could not be split (no Tripo spend).

assets.name: 烈焰马
assets.note: Flames came out as opaque orange/yellow geometry and read from the run camera; the real look is translucent fire, so a view-side flame flicker/aura (skill-vfx) would carry it. The near front leg has a small gap at the knee from Tripo (also in the raw mesh); invisible at swarm scale. Decimated to 1300: at 900 the flames tore UV seams into white flecks.

assets.name: 化石翼龙
assets.note: Guardian (desert zone 3), flies: static, undecimated, 1024px texture, like scyther. Hovering pose, wings raised in a shallow V with full membranes; the tail curls to its own left. Sheet 3 (views3/, v-back mirrored so the tail sits on the opposite image side from the front view); the first mesh had bare wing fingers with almost no membrane, see rejected.

rejected.reason: Wing membranes came back as bare finger bones with only a sliver of membrane near the body; spindly from the run camera for a guardian. (Its first download failed after billing; recovered with tripo task get --download, not regenerated.)
